claim_records.statement: I 2007–2008 kan Rikskonsertene dokumenteres som en offentlig finansiert institusjons- og patronatmekanisme som koblet statlige ressurser til organisert musikkarbeid og skolekonsertformidling: St.meld. nr. 21 registrerer statsbevilgning, DKS-midler og honorarrammer, mens resultatrapporteringen for 2007 dokumenterer 9 100 skolekonserter, om lag 800 turnerende musikere og om lag 60 prosent regional produksjon gjennom fylkeskommunale avtaler. Langdalens separate forskningsrapport viser at skolekonsertoppdrag for musikere som fikk innpass kunne være en betydelig inntektskilde. Dette dokumenterer en ressurs–institusjon–gjennomføring–arbeid/formidling-kjede, men ikke lik kvalitet eller faktisk tilgang for alle, representativ programmering eller at Rikskonsertene alene skapte varig karrieresuksess.
locators: St.meld. nr. 21 (2007–2008), 2.10.5: allocation, DKS funds and school-concert remuneration
St.prp. nr. 1 (2008–2009), Rapport 2007: 9,100 school concerts, about 800 touring musicians and about 60% regional production
Langdalen 2008, chapter 2, p. 89: bounded interview finding on school-concert work as musician income source
Prop. 1 S (2012–2013), Rapport 2011: later continuity control

object_scope.resource_layer: state appropriation, DKS funds and remuneration terms
object_scope.activity_layer: concert counts, attendance, touring musicians and regional production share
object_scope.labor_layer: bounded research finding on income significance for musicians obtaining assignments
object_scope.evidence_role: institutional resource-to-implementation chain, not an equality, quality or career-causality measure

claim_records.uncertainty: Administrative activity counts do not measure experienced quality, equal access, representativeness or unique audience reach. Langdalen's labor finding is interview-based and concerns musicians who obtained assignments. The 2011 report is a continuity check, not a causal estimate of the 2007–2008 allocation.
claim_records.prohibited_inference: Do not infer equal experienced access or quality, representative programming, unique voluntary demand, economic benefit for all musicians, or that Rikskonsertene alone caused durable careers, regional development or cultural equality.

reproducibility.primary_policy_document_status: persistent government fulltext with allocation/remuneration locators

boundary_records.release_effect: Requires separate implementation evidence and blocks treating policy intent as realized effect.

boundary_records.release_effect: Allows a bounded labor finding while blocking population and career-causality claims.
